propositions: Standing completion-verifier eval constructs one PydanticAIRunner before entering per-case disposable repositories, causing filesystem and ticket tools to read the checkout instead of case fixtures.
PydanticAIRunner._effective_config substitutes only the request model and preserves the runner's original LLMConfig.repo_path, so per-case repo_root passed to eval_solver.run_case is ignored.

Completion eval cases that require fixture code (CV-complete-feature, CV-complete-bugfix, CV-complete-refactor) fail because they cannot see fixture files like src/cli.py or app/profile.py in the checkout.
The fix re-roots the injected PydanticAIRunner at each disposable case store via evals/eval_solver.py::_rerooted and clears tickets_path so ticket tools read the fixture's seeded store.
After the fix, all 11 complete-verifier cases pass across 3 epochs with coverage 1.0 and epoch_pass=[True, True, True], demonstrating agents now read their own disposable fixture repositories.
